title: 获客成本 CAC 标准口径
description: 按渠道统计广告营销投放产出每一位有效线索/客户的平均成本
businessMetricFormula: CAC = 营销投放总金额 (SUM(spend)) / 获客成交客户总数 (COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id))
sqlTemplate: SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS total_spend, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_deals, ROUND(SUM(spend) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS cac FROM marketing_attribution GROUP BY channel ORDER BY cac ASC

title: 月度净营收 Net Revenue
description: 财务标准月度确认净营收，剔除当月退款、原路退回与渠道抵扣补贴
businessMetricFormula: 净营收 = 账面交易总流水 (SUM(gross_revenue)) - 退款总额 (SUM(refund_amount)) - 渠道优惠贴息 (SUM(discount_amount))
sqlTemplate: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', transaction_date) AS month, SUM(gross_revenue) - SUM(COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(discount_amount, 0)) AS net_revenue FROM financial_settlement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
